title: Why teens SHOULDN'T cut
summary: He warns skinny teens against copying shredded influencers by cutting or staying at maintenance. Skinny-fat lifters can hold maintenance, but skinny guys need a calorie surplus, patience and no supplements.
claims: Teens and skinny guys inspired by aesthetic influencers such as David Laid, Zyzz and Gymshark athletes copy their maintenance or cutting diets and almost never get results
Most of those shredded idols are on steroids
Do not restrict calories when trying to build muscle as a beginner, but do not chase very high body fat either
Skinny-fat lifters can stay at maintenance because their body has reserves to build muscle, but it is a slow process
Skinny hardgainers need a calorie surplus; you cannot build mass out of nothing
Eat until you start gaining weight; that shows you are in an anabolic state, and training directs the mass toward muscle
You do not need supplements to get bigger or shredded, only food, hard work and sleep
